description: Get a regular duplicate or duplicate-by-post job by jobId. Returns complete plus the created, failed and skipped objects. A partial job has created objects: created carries newId and the current name, failed carries stage and error.message, and retryable marks a step that can be retried from the Agent Inbox. Pending approvals have no job until they are approved in the Agent Inbox.
name: ads_get_duplication
title: Get Duplication Status
